verdict_reason: The driver changes correctly follow the new summary markup (grouped list items, chips labelled with the Latin name, Remove <Latin name>), but expectSpeciesSelected spells the commodity-line locator twice.

todos.issue: expectSpeciesSelected builds the commodity-line locator twice: once as commodityLine (line 668, page.getByText(`${commodityCode}:`, { exact: true })) to filter the group, then again by hand at line 674 (group.getByText(`${commodityCode}:`, { exact: true })) for the visibility assertion. Two spellings of one locator can drift apart, and the reader has to compare them to see they are the same.
todos.fix: Must: the commodity line in the selected summary is located by one expression, used both to pick the group and to assert it is visible. One way: assert await expect(group.locator(commodityLine)).toBeVisible(), or drop the first assertion and assert expect(group).toBeVisible(), since the filter already requires the line.
